correctness.rationale: Four distinct simple rational poles on P1 give genus six by the Artin–Schreier genus formula, one rational point over each pole. For 3∤r translation x→x+1 cycles the field traces of f(x)=x+1/(x³-x) through F3, forcing 3^r+1 point count. Independent exact finite-field enumeration in F27 and F729 using alternative irreducible polynomials gave trace distributions (24,0,0) and (222,252,252), with independent y³-y image counting; hence N3=76 and N6=670. Newton identities and Weil functional equation force all thirteen P_X coefficients, and direct factor multiplication plus quartic rational irreducibility and Honda–Tate give stated F3 isogeny and order.
residual_risks: The arithmetic assertion is restricted to the coefficient-one F3 curve; no assertion for twists or geometric simplicity.
